# northflank_secret_group (Data Source)

Looks up a secret group in a Northflank project, either by its `id` or by its `name`. Set exactly one of them.

`variables` holds the group's own decrypted values, not those inherited from linked addons, and ends up in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By ID.
data "northflank_secret_group" "by_id" {
  project_id = "my-application"
  id         = "api-secrets"
}

# By name. variables holds the group's own decrypted values.
data "northflank_secret_group" "by_name" {
  project_id = "my-application"
  name       = "API Secrets"
}

output "database_url" {
  value     = data.northflank_secret_group.by_name.variables["DATABASE_URL"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the secret group belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the secret group. Set this to look the group up by ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the secret group. Set this to look the group up by name, which lists the project's secret groups to find it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `description` (String) Short description of the secret group.
- `priority` (Number) Priority used to merge secret groups that define the same key.
- `restrictions` (Attributes) Which resources inherit the secret group. Null when it is not restricted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))
- `secret_type` (String) Where the variables are injected: `environment-arguments`, `environment` or `arguments`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags attached to the secret group.
- `type` (String) Permission type of the group: `secret` or `config`.
- `updated_at` (String) Time of the last update, in RFC 3339 format.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) The group's secret variables, as a map of name to decrypted value.

<a id="nestedatt--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions`

Read-Only:

- `resources` (Attributes Set) Services and jobs the secret group is restricted to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions--resources))
- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether the restrictions apply.
- `stage_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the environments the secret group is restricted to.
- `tag_match_condition` (String) Whether a resource needs `and` all of `tags`, or `or` any one of them.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags a resource must carry to inherit the secret group.

<a id="nestedatt--restrictions--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions.resources`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the service or job.
- `type` (String) Kind of resource: `service` or `job`.
